Working notes — ticket routing

Goal: assign tickets to correct desk. Options: A (standard queue), B (priority desk), C (regional office).

Evidence:
- REQ-2400: large refund, north region. Chose B -> rejected.
- REQ-2401–2409: chose C -> rejected every time.
  These covered: shipments, refunds, claims; north/south/east regions; small/large sizes; senders in Field Sales, Client Services, Partner Accounts, Regional Ops, Finance Desk; varied urgency and prior-attempt wording. None made C valid.

Implications:
- C (regional office) has failed across all observed combinations. Do not default to C without new evidence.
- B (priority desk) is not valid for a large north-region refund. Only one B test, so limited evidence.
- A (standard queue) is the only untried option in observed cases. Try A next for similar routing decisions.

Open question:
- No positive example yet for B or C. If A is rejected, reassess whether some hidden condition (region/type/size/sender) selects B/C.

Keep notes concise and update only if actual success/failure changes the pattern.

Working notes — ticket routing

Goal: assign ticket to A (standard queue), B (priority desk), or C (regional office).

Updated evidence:
- A accepted for REQ-2411–2414: small refunds, south region. Senders varied (Field Sales, Regional Ops, Client Services), wording varied. So A is valid for small south refunds.
- A rejected for: small east invoice (2410), large east invoice (2418), small north claim (2415–2416), small south shipment (2417), small south claim (2419). A is not a general default.
- C rejected for all tested REQ-2401–2409 (shipments, refunds, claims; all regions/sizes/senders). Avoid C unless new positive evidence.
- B rejected once for large north refund (REQ-2400). No positive example.

Implications:
- Request type is now the strongest predictor. Refund -> try A (confirmed for small south). Claim/shipment/invoice -> A invalid.
- Region, size, sender, and wording did not make A valid for non-refund types.
- C remains broadly invalid. B is still largely untested.

Next actions:
- Small south refunds: choose A.
- Non-refunds: do not use A or C; test B next if available.
- If B fails for non-refunds, reassess hidden condition by type/size/region.

Open question:
- Correct desk for claims, shipments, invoices, and large/other-region refunds. No positive evidence yet for B or C.

Working notes — ticket routing

Goal: assign ticket to A (standard), B (priority), C (regional).

Confirmed positives:
- A: small south refunds only (REQ-2411–2414). A rejected for small north refund (2429), large south refund (2423), large north refund (2420), and all non-refunds tested. A is not a default.
- B: shipments accepted across tested sizes/regions/senders (large/small north, small east: 2422, 2426–2428). Also large north claim accepted (2421). B rejected for small south claim (2425). No B test for refunds/invoices yet.
- C: rejected all tested (2401–2409). Avoid C unless positive evidence.

Implications:
- Shipment -> B.
- Large north claim -> B; small south claim -> not B. Claims likely depend on size/region; no rule for all claims.
- Refund -> only small south is known A. Other refunds: A invalid; C invalid; B untested. Do not use A for large refunds or non-south small refunds.
- Sender/wording not useful so far.

Next actions:
- Shipment: choose B.
- Large north claim: choose B. Other claims: avoid A/C; try B if untested, but note B failed small south claim.
- Refund: small south -> A. Small north / large any region -> avoid A/C; test B next.
- Invoice: avoid A/C; test B next.
- If B fails for refunds/invoices/small claims, revisit hidden condition by type+size+region.

Open question:
- Correct desks for refunds outside small south, invoices, and small/other-region claims. B is promising for shipments and large north claims, but not universal. Option D is invalid.

Working notes — ticket routing

Goal: assign ticket to A (standard), B (priority), C (regional).

A: only known valid for small south refunds (REQ-2411–2414). Invalid for small north refund, large south/north refund, and all non-refunds tested. Not default.

B:
- Shipments: accepted large north (2430); rejected small north (2437). Prior small east accepted. Do not assume all shipments.
- Claims: accepted small north (2435), small east (2431), large north (2421). Rejected small south (2425), large south (2434, 2439). So B works for north/east claims, fails south claims.
- Refunds: rejected small north (2432, 2436), small east (2433). Not for tested refunds.
- Invoices: accepted large east (2438). Use B for invoices unless contrary.

C: rejected all tested (2401–2409). Avoid unless positive evidence.

Rules:
- Shipment: large north or small east -> B. Small north -> not B; unknown A/C (A likely invalid).
- Claim: north/east -> B. South -> not B; A/C likely invalid, so unknown.
- Refund: small south -> A. Other refunds: A/C invalid; B failed small north/east. Unknown for large/other.
- Invoice: B (tested large east).
- Sender/wording not useful.

Next actions:
- Shipment: large north/small east -> B. Small north -> avoid B; test or revisit hidden condition.
- Claim: north/east -> B. South -> avoid A/B/C; hidden condition.
- Refund: small south -> A. Other -> avoid A/B/C; maybe test B for large refunds, but B failed small refunds.
- Invoice: choose B.
- If B fails, revisit type+size+region.

Open: correct desks for south claims, non-small-south refunds, small north shipments.

Working notes — ticket routing

Goal: assign ticket to A/B/C. D invalid when offered.

A: only known valid for small south refunds (REQ-2411–2414). Invalid for small north refund, large refunds, all non-refunds tested. Not default.

B:
- Claims: works for north/east (small/large): 2421, 2431, 2435, 2440, 2446, 2448. Fails south claims: 2425, 2434, 2439. Rule: north/east claim -> B; south claim -> not B.
- Shipments: small east accepted earlier; large north mixed (2430 accepted, 2445 rejected); small north rejected (2437). Do not trust size/region alone; B unreliable for shipments.
- Refunds: fails tested small north/east; no accepted refund. Avoid B.
- Invoices: large east mixed (2438 accepted, 2447 rejected); small north/south rejected (2444, 2449). B unreliable for invoices; avoid unless new positive evidence.

C: rejected all tested (2401–2409). Avoid unless positive evidence.

Rules:
- Claim: north/east -> B. South -> avoid A/B/C; hidden condition.
- Refund: small south -> A. Other refunds -> avoid A/B/C.
- Shipment: not solved. Small east -> B maybe. Small north -> not B. Large north uncertain (mixed).
- Invoice: not solved. B has one success but multiple failures; test hidden condition or avoid B.
- Sender/wording not useful. D invalid.

Next actions:
- Claims: north/east B; south needs hidden condition.
- Refunds: small south A; others need hidden condition.
- Shipments/invoices: gather more; do not default B. For shipment small east try B; large north unknown. For invoice avoid B if possible.

Open: correct desks for south claims, non-small-south refunds, shipments, invoices.

Working notes — ticket routing

Goal: assign ticket to A/B/C. D invalid.

A: no longer reliable. Small south refunds rejected (2451, 2452); earlier small-south positives superseded. Other tested non-refunds invalid.

B: Claims north/east valid (2421 etc.); south claims fail. Shipments unreliable: small east rejected (2457), small north rejected (2437), large north mixed. Refunds: avoid; large south rejected (2450). Invoices unreliable: small east rejected (2454); large east mixed; avoid unless positive.

C: Not blanket avoid. Large south refund accepted (2458). Rejected: small south shipment (2459); small north invoice (2453); large east invoice (2456). Avoid C for invoices/shipments unless new positive.

Rules:
- Claim: north/east -> B. South -> hidden condition; avoid A/B/C without evidence.
- Refund: large south -> C. Small south -> A rejected; B untested, consider C/hidden. Small east -> not A.
- Shipment: unsolved. Small east not B; small south not C; small north not B; large north mixed.
- Invoice: unsolved. B unreliable; C rejected small north/large east. Test A/hidden; avoid B/C if possible.
- Sender/wording not useful.

Next actions:
- Claims: north/east B; south needs hidden condition.
- Refunds: large south C; small south test C or hidden.
- Shipments/invoices: gather more; do not default B or C. For shipment small east avoid B; small south avoid C. For invoice avoid B/C unless new positive.

Open: correct desks for south claims, small south refunds, shipments, invoices.
